subject: Re: Logging & redaction controls request/response logs and headers

Subject: Recap: Logging controls & redaction (post-demo)

Hi Alice / Bob -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps on logging / redaction items so your security team can evaluate: 

1) What we captured during the demo
- Redwood stores request/response traces for a rolling 30-day window by default.
- We showed configurable retention windows (30/90/365 days) per customer and per route.
- We demoed runtime redaction rules that can mask PII in both request and response logs before write. Rules support regex, JSON-path, and header-level masking.
- Trace IDs are present in logs for correlating requests, but can be pseudonymized with a per-customer salt.

2) Outstanding questions you asked
- Can we avoid storing raw prompt text? Yes - we can apply strict redaction or only persist metadata and embeddings.
- How do we handle headers (authorization, cookies, x-trace-id)? We strip sensitive headers by default and allow a allowlist for non-sensitive headers.
- Can logs be sent to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog) without sensitive payloads? Yes - forwarding integrations redact payloads on the integration layer.

3) Next steps / deliverables (I'll attach docs)
- Send detailed redaction design doc (attached).
- Provide retention & deletion SLA language for the contract.
- Rishi (cc'd) to scope a short SE call to walk your sec team through the redaction rule builder.

Attachments: redaction_design.pdf, pii_retention_policy.xlsx

If that aligns, I'll get those docs over and propose times for a technical review.

Cheers,
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments - quick read-through raised a few security items we need clarified before moving to POC: 

- Retention: Can you confirm deletion is immediate after retention expires (i.e., hard delete from object store + indices)? We need an auditable deletion flow.
- Redaction guarantees: For responses, if a model echoes user PII (account numbers, SSNs) we need a guarantee that such tokens are not persisted in any form. Is the masking performed in-memory prior to any persistence?
- Headers: We saw x-trace-id in your demo logs. We need the option to pseudonymize trace IDs (so they are reproducible for debugging but not reversible).
- Encryption: Do you support customer-managed keys for logs at rest in Private deployments?

Can we schedule Rishi's SE session next week (preferred Tue/Wed)? Also looping Bob from our infra team for the deletion question.

Best,
Alice
Product Security, FinTechCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: FinTechCo Security <security@fintechco.com>, Alice Park <alice.park@fintechco.com>

Date: 2026-06-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Logging controls & redaction (post-demo) - answers + next steps

Hi Alice / Bob -

Thanks - quick answers inline, and proposed next steps: 

- Deletion / retention: We perform a hard delete from object storage and remove indices; deletion is asynchronous but auditable. We’ll send the deletion flow chart + retention SLA language for the contract. (See attachment: pii_retention_policy.xlsx)

- Redaction timing: All configured redaction rules run in the inference runtime before any log write. In practice this means masking is applied to the request/response payload in-memory; nothing that matches the rule is serialized to disk. I’ve noted your strict requirement and we can add a test to the POC to prove zero persisted matches for a test prompt set.

- Trace IDs: We support pseudonymization via HMAC with a per-customer secret. That produces reproducible but non-reversible trace ids. Optionally, we can drop trace ids from persisted logs entirely and only keep them in ephemeral metrics.

- CMK / Encryption: For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys for logs at rest and can provide key rotation docs.

Next steps:
1) Dylan to run a 45m technical walk-through with your sec/infra team (propose 2026-06-23 or 2026-06-24).
2) I’ll share a short test plan for the POC to validate redaction guarantees and deletion.
3) Legal will add the retention SLA language to the upcoming SOW.

Please confirm preferred time for the SE session and we’ll lock it in.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pii_retention_policy.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)]
